text:
[issue by mlq1819] ### Description This is a duplicate of https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/issues/7554; however, that ticket is closed, and this issue appears to still be occurring in 6.0.10. Specifically, this is when placing multiple packagers on the same non-vault block, such as a storage drawer. The inventory will be duplicated, even if it's accessing the same block. Note: this inventory is on a simulated grid, on a server. If the duplication-checker uses block coordinates, this could be the issue. If possible, it would be helpful if this was made to interface properly with multiple storage drawer IO ports on the same drawer network, though I understand that's a mod compatibility issue. For now, the fact remains that this occurs even on the same inventory location. ### Game Log https://mclo.gs/KgqDpAz ### Debug Information
